_comment: Maximums for scripts/size_report.py (ADR-0042). Each is about 15 percent above the number measured on 2026-10-24 (after the lazy Map and the minified editor, IND-186, IND-214, IND-215). The graph limits were set on 2026-11-04 from the measured lazy module (IND-245, ADR-0048) and re-measured after the focus window (IND-246: 14.7 KB raw, 6.3 KB gzip); python_source_bytes was raised to 600000 for the Graph component. A pull request that needs more room raises a limit here, in the same diff, and says why in its description and the CHANGELOG. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored.
